table.name: properties
table.summary: A master table containing unique identifiers and basic descriptive attributes for real estate properties.

property_type_code.name: property_type_code
property_type_code.meaning: A short textual code or label indicating the type of the property (e.g., residential, commercial).

property_id.name: property_id
property_id.meaning: A unique numeric identifier assigned to each property record.

other_details.name: other_details
other_details.meaning: Additional contextual information about the property, currently observed to contain country codes.
